youLoseLabel: What you lose by doing this
recommendedOrder: Recommendation: first delete the stored activity, then disable collection.

delete.title: Delete your location history (Timeline)
steps: Press "Open the exact page": your Google Maps Timeline will open in your browser.
At the bottom right, press the gear icon.
Choose "Delete all location history".
Tick the confirmation box and press "Delete".
delete.youLose: Google Maps will no longer show your timeline or the places you've been.

disable.title: Disable recording of your location
steps: Press "Open the exact page": "Activity controls" will open in your Google account.
Find the "Timeline" or "Location History" section.
Press "Turn off" and confirm.
disable.youLose: Google Maps won't remember your places or improve recommendations based on where you've been.

delete.title: Delete your search history
steps: Press "Open the exact page": Google's "My Activity" will open.
At the top, press "Delete" and choose "All time".
Select the "Search" product and confirm.
delete.youLose: Autocomplete will stop suggesting past searches.

disable.title: Disable saving of your web & app activity
steps: Press "Open the exact page": "Activity controls" will open.
Find "Web & App Activity".
Press "Turn off" and confirm.
disable.youLose: Search, Maps and Assistant will become less personalized.

delete.title: Delete your YouTube history
steps: Press "Open the exact page": your YouTube history will open.
In the right-hand menu choose "Clear all watch history".
Confirm with "Clear watch history".

disable.title: Pause recording of what you watch on YouTube
steps: Press "Open the exact page": "Activity controls" will open.
Find "YouTube History".
Press "Turn off" and confirm.
disable.youLose: YouTube won't remember what you watched or fine-tune recommendations.

disable.title: Disable ad personalization
steps: Press "Open the exact page": Google's My Ad Center will open.
Under "Customize ads", turn personalization off.
Confirm.
disable.youLose: You'll still see ads, but generic ones (not based on you).

derived.title: What can't be deleted: derived models
steps: Read the honesty notice below.
If you want to go further, your account's "Data & privacy" page has more options.
Consider requesting full account deletion if you no longer use it.
